(361)rgyud lugs 'jam dpal bskang ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bzhugs so/'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas/tshogs bsogs tha

tei:div.tei:p: rgyud lugs 'jam dpal bskang ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bzhugs so/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas/ tshogs bsogs thugs dam bskang ba dang*/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ skong ba'i rim pa bshad par bya/ de yang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rjogs shing mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa'i phyir skong ba'i rim pa/ tshogs dang mchod pa'i bye brag gzab rgyas su bshams te/ nam mkha' mjod kyi sngags rgyas bskang rdzas rnams spel te/ oṃ/ 'og min dag pa me tog bkod/ rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing khams nas/ bla ma mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma/ sangs rgyas sras bcas 'phags pa'i tshogs/ sngon gyi thugs dam chen po bzhin/ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ padma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ sems kyi yid bzhin gter chen po'i/ rnam 'phrul phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin/ kun bzang mchod pa'i rnam rol gyis/ rgyal ba'i zhing kun mnyes byed (362)pa/ 'daud yon lnga yi tshogs chen pos/ gdod ma'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur/ kun bzang yab yum thugs dam bskang*/ lnga ldan longs spyod rjogs pa'i sku/ rigs lnga'i rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ gsang chen dkyil 'khor rigs kyi bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang*/ dbus phrag rgyud kyi ston pa mchog dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*/ mkhyen rab rnon po'i dngos grub brnyes/ 'jam dpal gshes gnyen thugs dam bskang*/ snang bzhi mthar phyin 'od kyi sku/ shrī seng ha'i thugs dam bskang*/ mngal gyis ma gos sprul pa'i sku/ padma thod phreng thugs dam bskang*/ gsang sngags rgyud kyi gnyer 'jin pa/ ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang*/ mkha' 'gros byin rlabs lung bstan thob/ padma las 'brel thugs dam bskang*/

gti mug rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ de bzhin rigs kyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ yum mchog sangs rgyas dbyings phyug ma/ sras dang bcas (363)pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ zhe sdang rnam dag me long dang*/ rdo rje rigs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ yum mchog rdo rje thugs dam bskang*/ sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid dang*/ rin chen rigs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ yum mchog rin chen thugs dam bskang*/ sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog dang*/ padma rigs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ yum mchog padma thugs dam bskang*/ sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ngang*/ las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ yum mchog las kyi thugs dam bskang*/ sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ rigs rnams ma lus 'dus pa'i dpal/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ ye shes sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das/ shes rab lha mo dbyangs can ma/ rnam mang rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ nyan thos rang rgyal 'phags bzhi'i tshogs/ (364)thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i phyir/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ zhal zas rol mos thugs dam bskang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ 'dod yon lnga yis thugs dam bskang*/ dga' bzhi mchog gis mnyes byed pa/ rdo rje rig ma'i tshogs kyis bskang*/ blo stong ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi/ de bzhin nyid kyi rtogs pas bskang*/ lha dang rtog pa dbyer med pa/ zung 'jug sbyor ba'i mchod pas bskang*/ gzung 'jin yul dang yul can kun/ mnyam nyid dbyings su bsgral bas bskang*/ de ltar bskang zhing gsol ba'i mthus/ ma rig sems kyi sgrib dag nas/ rang byung de bzhin nyid kyi sku/ ye shes sems dpa'i zhal mthong zhing*/ gzungs dang spobs pa mi zad pa'i/ dngos grub gter chen bdag la stsol/ mthar thug don dam 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ mgon po khyed dang dbyer med pa'i go 'phang mchog la sbyor gyur cig
ces pa'ang 'jigs mos ngor padma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge legs su gyur cig phyag bris las bshus nas zhu dag// /
